title: The Early Church's Prayer and Fellowship
description: After their release, the believers gathered and prayed to God, quoting Psalm 2 about the nations rising up against the Lord's Anointed. When they had prayed, the place where they were meeting shook, and all were filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke God's word with boldness. The believers were one in heart and soul, held everything in common, and distributed to each as anyone had need. Joseph, whom the apostles called Barnabas (son of encouragement), sold a field and laid the money at the apostles' feet.
